story: A Ruflo swarm (queen + workers) is let loose. Each agent has a written mandate (an ABP) and memory in an sgit vault. The same 11 actions are tried twice: Ruflo's default allows all 11; with the ABP, 6 are stopped (4 denied, 2 sent to a named human for approval) and 5 are allowed, and every decision becomes a hash-chained receipt (11 each side, ledger valid). Each role writes what it learned on its own vault branch, encrypted on the client (the server sees ciphertext), the branches merge, and a fresh clone gets the same memory back. At the end of the run, one vault holds everything that happened: the evidence.
facts_source: site/data/report.json (11 actions, 4 denied, 2 approval_required, 5 allowed, ledger valid 11+11), site/data/abp.json (6 roles, 36 rows, 0 gaps, owner Dinis Cruz, valid until 2026-10-31), site/data/poc2-run.txt (vault history: init, init: memory vault, coder learned, tester learned)

rules: one self-contained HTML file per version at site/studio/<id>/index.html; no build step
scripts only from cdnjs.cloudflare.com with an exact version (three.js: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js)
read numbers from ../../data/report.json and ../../data/abp.json at load; never type a number the data does not hold
1600x900 first, also fine at 390 px wide; dark background; autoplay a loop of 25 to 40 seconds; no audio
a corner label: '<id> · <title> · made in the ruv.sgit.ai studio run' and a link back to ../index.html
no console errors; expose window.__t() returning seconds into the loop
